svg.title: Vale sets the integration target before Riju, Ila, and Cecil beneath an imprecise clock.
svg.desc: Vale briefs the group beside a field reserved for the ninety-eight-per-cent target. Behind them, a wall clock has no minute hand, undercutting the target's six-decimal precision.
svg.text: Page 21, panel 1 · Wide conference-room shot from behind an empty chair

text.tspan: Vale fixes the live-migration threshold at
ninety-eight per cent and explains that the standard
is intended to stop weak matches entering public

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
